description: The bar chart illustrates the effect sizes of various models—XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—on four linguistic tags: case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," ranges from -5 to 20, with error bars indicating variability. The horizontal axis displays the linguistic tags. For the "case" tag, XLM-B₂ shows the highest effect (approximately 12), followed by mBERT-B₂ (around 12), XLM-L₂ (around 6), mBERT-R₂ (around 3), and XLM-R₂ (around 3). For "gender," XLM-B₂ has the highest effect (around 4), followed by mBERT-B₂ (around 4), XLM-L₂ (around 2), mBERT-R₂ (around 2), and XLM-R₂ (around 1). For "number," XLM-B₂ and mBERT-B₂ have similar effects (around 3), while XLM-L₂ and mBERT-R₂ are around 1, and XLM-R₂ is around 1. For "tense," all models show very small effects, with XLM-B₂ and mBERT-B₂ around 1, XLM-L₂ and mBERT-R₂ around 1, and XLM-R₂ around 0. The legend indicates that the models are represented by different colors: XLM-L₂ (light blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red).
